views.label: One login, one listing
views.note: Open service root first; the Systems GET is the only login attempt, and a 401 is never retried.

views.label: Per-VM walk
views.note: Four VMs at a time; a stopped VM's links are UNKNOWN, never DOWN.

views.label: One write per server
views.note: Classify, evaluate health, audit and upsert in the same write.

messages.label: health_check: GET /redfish/v1 (open service root, no login)
GET each System (serial, UUID, PowerState, Oem.KubeVirt.NodeName)
404 → vanished, skipped; timeout or error → recorded, no stub
System read but map failed → COLLECTION_ERROR stub
classify + evaluate health + audit, revision CAS write

cards.title: One collector per KubeVirt cluster
items: Manager id is mgr_kubevirt_<cluster slug>; INVENTORY_KUBEVIRT_CLUSTER_NAME is required and the chart fails without clusterName (ADR-0060)
Schedule is collectors.kubevirt.schedule, default every 3 hours (server-scan-collectors values.yaml)
HTTP Basic, no sessions, so not RedfishClient; a login is never retried because the facade blocks an IP after 10 failures in 5 minutes (ADR-0058)

cards.title: What a VM is stored as
items: Serial is the firmware serial, else the System Id; recreating a VM without its firmware block mints a new document (ADR-0058)
Vendor kubevirt, server_type vm derived; vm_host holds cluster and node, and host-model/host-passthrough are stored as no model (ADR-0059)
A stopped VM's links are UNKNOWN, never DOWN, and network.single_link_up does not apply to VMs (ADR-0058)

cards.title: Failure containment and live pass
items: Only a VM whose System was read then failed to map becomes a stub; a vanished VM, a timeout or a rejected login never does (ADR-0062)
get_one reads one System by its external_id path and raises NotThisManagersServerError for another facade's VM (ADR-0032)
Live pass 2026-11-08: a stopped VM updated in place with links UNKNOWN; a deleted VM was one fewer server, no error (kubevirt-collectors.md)
